verses.title: Steady action
verses.transliteration: yogasthah kuru karmani sangam tyaktva dhananjaya
verses.plain: Stand in steadiness, act, and loosen the grip on result-attachment.
verses.caution: Use as a source candidate for reflection, not a command, diagnosis, or promise of peace.
verses.chant: Read slowly. Do not imitate ritual recitation or claim pronunciation authority.
interpretations: Do not turn this into productivity pressure.
verses.carry: Do one small duty slowly and clearly before checking the outcome.

verses.title: Illumined attention
verses.transliteration: tat savitur varenyam bhargo devasya dhimahi
verses.plain: A revered Vedic mantra often approached as a meditation on illumination and discernment.
verses.caution: Sacred mantra handling needs lineage humility, rights awareness for translations, and pronunciation care.
verses.chant: Show source and transliteration only. Avoid audio authority until licensed guidance exists.
interpretations: Do not flatten into generic positivity.
verses.carry: Pause once today and ask what deserves clear attention.

verses.title: Pleasant and beneficial
verses.plain: A source candidate for distinguishing what is merely pleasant from what is deeply beneficial.
verses.caution: Do not use this to shame choices, judge another life, or create moral superiority.
verses.chant: Use as study support, not recitation coaching.
verses.carry: Name one choice and ask whether it only comforts the moment or also serves clarity.

verses.title: Restraint with responsibility
verses.plain: A compact source often discussed around seeing the world with reverence and restraint.
verses.caution: Keep this in review before public guidance; do not advise abandoning duties, safety, shelter, or care.
words: by the Lord or the divine
verses.chant: Mark as review-needed. No ritual, renunciation, or life-direction authority.
verses.carry: Soften one attachment without neglecting a real responsibility.
